Who We Are

Built on Expertise.
Driven by Excellence.

Majan Oils is headquartered in the Salalah Free Zone, Sultanate of Oman. Strategically positioned as a gateway connecting the energy markets of the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. Our operations span the full spectrum of the energy and industrial sectors, delivering integrated solutions that power economies and communities.

From petroleum exploration and refining to fuel distribution, chemical trading, and large-scale construction, we combine deep industry knowledge with operational excellence to serve a diverse portfolio of clients across the region.

What We Do

Our Operations
& Capabilities

Port of Salalah

Biofuel Production

Processing and refining of sustainable biofuel feedstocks into clean, renewable energy products for commercial and industrial use.

Port of Salalah

Biofuel Derivatives & By-Products

Secondary processing of biofuel outputs to produce value-added derivatives for a range of downstream applications.

Port of Salalah

Fuel Oil Storage

Large-scale fuel oil storage facilities designed for safe, high-capacity containment and rapid throughput at port-side locations.

Port of Salalah

Marine Bunkering

Ship-to-shore and shore-to-ship fuel supply services, providing reliable bunkering operations for vessels at the Port of Salalah.

Salalah Free Zone

Oil Tank Storage & Logistics Hub

Centralized petroleum storage and logistics facility within the Salalah Free Zone, serving as a strategic distribution hub for regional and international energy markets.
